caption: The drawing features two separate objects placed against a plain, light brown background. On the left side, there is a boxy, old-fashioned iron with a broad, flat metal base and a hollow opening on the front side. This iron has a thick, rounded wooden handle attached to a vertical metal frame extending from the back to the front, with a small round yellowish knob on top. The iron is colored in brown shades with the handle in a slightly lighter brown and greenish hue. On the right side, there is a metal tool with a cylindrical wooden handle, similar in color to the iron's handle, fixed to a triangular metal frame. The frame extends outward and downward, ending in three legs, forming a trivet or stand that appears to be designed to hold or support the iron. Both objects are colored in muted, natural tones of brown and metal, drawn with a realistic texture and shading, positioned with some space between them on the page.
title: Iron and Trivet
